issue.input_source: Public hourly ARCO ERA5 v3 reduced to complete UTC daily means for 2026-09-21 and 2026-09-22
issue.scientific_status: ERA5 reference initialization matched to the native model reforecast system; research reference, not near-real-time guidance.

initial_condition_source.label: ERA5 reanalysis reference
initial_condition_source.description: Delayed ERA5 reanalysis daily means used as a scientifically matched reference initialization; not a real-time forecast feed.

climatology_alignment.operation_order: interpolate each yearly native-ensemble mean, aggregate seven lead days, then equally average 20 years

observation_verification.message: Verification is withheld until every required observation day in a valid week is available.

initialization_comparison.message: Pairwise differences measure sensitivity to the initial-condition source. They do not show which forecast is better; skill requires observations for each complete valid period.

wind850_climatology_alignment.operation_order: interpolate each yearly 51-member vector mean, aggregate seven lead days, then equally average 20 years

definitions.wind850_mean: shading: speed computed from the weekly ensemble-mean U/V components; arrows: the same weekly ensemble-mean U/V components
definitions.wind850_anomaly: shading: ensemble-mean vector speed minus the equally weighted mean of 20 yearly vector speeds; arrows: forecast U/V mean minus the 2002-2021 U/V model climatology

wind850_provenance.definition: shading: ensemble-mean vector speed minus the equally weighted mean of 20 yearly vector speeds; arrows: forecast U/V mean minus the 2002-2021 U/V model climatology

grid.value_order: latitude-major row order; latitude is north-to-south

rainfall_anomaly.label: Rainfall anomaly
rainfall_anomaly.description: Weekly-mean forecast minus lead-matched model climatology

temperature_anomaly.label: Temperature anomaly
temperature_anomaly.description: Weekly-mean forecast minus lead-matched model climatology

wind850_mean.label: Weekly mean 850 hPa wind
wind850_mean.description: Shading is the speed of the weekly ensemble-mean wind vector; arrows are the weekly ensemble-mean U/V components

wind850_anomaly.label: 850 hPa wind anomaly
wind850_anomaly.description: Shading is the weekly-mean wind-speed anomaly; arrows are the weekly U/V vector-component anomaly
